title: eludite/build/progress
description: Host-to-shell notification: how far the build is, recognized from MSBuild's console output (a project's `Name -> output` line completes it; canonical `error` and `warning` lines are counted). Sent at most every 100 ms while something changes. Advisory: the authoritative result is eludite/build/finished.

buildId.description: The build's id, unique within one host process, from 1.

projectsTotal.description: Projects the build covers (the solution's projects, or 1 for a project build).

currentProject.description: The project whose output line came last.
